mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_email_verification_code (id, purpose, username, email, phone, code_hash, expire_time, used_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{purpose}, #{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{codeHash}, #{expireTime}, #{usedTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, purpose, username, email, phone, code_hash, expire_time, used_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM t_email_verification_code WHERE email = #{email} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_time IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
